intro_en: The great scholar Shaykh Ahmad ibn Abi Talib al-Tabarsi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrates in the noble book al-Ihtijaj that this came out from the holy side to Muhammad al-Himyari, after the answers to the questions he had asked the Imam:

sections.t_en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. You neither grasp His command nor accept from His friends; it is a far-reaching wisdom, yet warnings avail nothing. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon the progeny of Yaseen.
sections.note_en: When you wish to turn to Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, through us and toward us, say as Allah the Exalted has said:

sections.t_en: Peace be upon you, O caller to Allah and the manifestation of His signs.
Peace be upon you, O door of Allah and guardian of His religion.
Peace be upon you, O vicegerent of Allah and helper of His truth.
Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah and guide to His will.
Peace be upon you, O reciter of the Book of Allah and its interpreter.
Peace be upon you in the hours of your night and the stretches of your day.
Peace be upon you, O remnant of Allah on His earth.
Peace be upon you, O covenant of Allah which He took and confirmed.
Peace be upon you, O promise of Allah which He guaranteed.
Peace be upon you, O raised banner, overflowing knowledge, source of help and vast mercy, a promise that is not false.
Peace be upon you when you stand.
Peace be upon you when you sit.
Peace be upon you when you recite and explain.
Peace be upon you when you pray and make supplication.
Peace be upon you when you bow and prostrate.
Peace be upon you when you say “There is no god but Allah” and “Allah is the Greatest”.
Peace be upon you when you praise Allah and seek forgiveness.
Peace be upon you when you enter the morning and the evening.
Peace be upon you in the night when it envelops and in the day when it becomes manifest.
Peace be upon you, O trusted and protected Imam.
Peace be upon you, O foremost leader in whom hope is placed.
Peace be upon you with the most comprehensive of salutations.
O my Master, I call you as a witness that I testify there is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner.
And that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger; there is no beloved except him and his family.
O my Master, I call you as a witness that Ali, the Commander of the Faithful, is His proof.
And Hasan is His proof, and Husayn is His proof.
And Ali son of Husayn is His proof, and Muhammad son of Ali is His proof.
And Ja'far son of Muhammad is His proof, and Musa son of Ja'far is His proof.
And Ali son of Musa is His proof, and Muhammad son of Ali is His proof.
And Ali son of Muhammad is His proof, and Hasan son of Ali is His proof.
And I testify that you are the proof of Allah. All of you are the first and the last.
And that your return is true, with no doubt in it.
The day when faith will not benefit a soul that did not believe before, or earned no good through its faith.
And that death is true, and that Nakir and Nakeer are true.
And I testify that the resurrection is true and the raising is true.
And that the Bridge is true, the Watching-place is true, the Balance is true and the Gathering is true.
And the Reckoning is true, Paradise and the Fire are true, and the promise and the warning concerning them are true.
O my Master, wretched is the one who opposes you and fortunate is the one who obeys you. So bear witness to what I have made you witness to.
And I am a friend of yours, free from your enemy.
So the truth is whatever pleases you, and falsehood is whatever angers you.
And the good is whatever you have commanded, and the evil is whatever you have forbidden.
So my soul believes in Allah alone, with no partner, in His Messenger and in the Commander of the Faithful.
And in you, O my Master, the first of you and the last of you.
My support is prepared for you, and my love is purely for you.
Amen! Amen! (Accept! Accept!)
O Allah, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad, the Prophet of Your mercy and the word of Your light,
sections.note_en: After it, this supplication is recited:

sections.t_en: and that You fill my heart with the light of certainty, my chest with the light of faith, my thought with the light of good intentions and my resolve with the light of knowledge,
my strength with the light of action, my tongue with the light of truthfulness and my religion with the light of insight from You,
my sight with the light of brightness, my hearing with the light of wisdom and my love with the light of allegiance to Muhammad and his family, peace be upon them,
until I meet You having fulfilled Your covenant and Your pledge, so that Your mercy envelops me, O Guardian, O Praiseworthy.
O Allah, send blessings upon (Muhammad), Your proof on Your earth, Your vicegerent in Your lands and the caller to Your path,
the one who upholds Your justice, who rises by Your command, the guardian of the believers, the destroyer of the disbelievers and the dispeller of darkness,
the illuminator of truth, the speaker of wisdom and honesty, Your perfect word on Your earth, the one who watches and fears, and the sincere guardian,
the ship of salvation, the banner of guidance, the light of the eyes of mankind and the best of those who have worn a shirt and a cloak,
and the remover of blindness (gloom), who will fill the earth with justice and equity as it was filled with injustice and oppression. Indeed You have power over all things.

O Allah, send blessings upon Your guardian, the son of Your guardians, whose obedience You made obligatory, whose right You made binding, from whom You removed impurity and whom You purified with a thorough purification.
O Allah, grant him victory, give victory to Your religion through him, and through him help Your friends, his friends, his Shia and his supporters, and make us among them.
O Allah, shelter him from the evil of every rebel and tyrant and from the evil of all Your creation,
protect him from before him and behind him, from his right and from his left, guard him and prevent any harm from reaching him,
and preserve through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger, make justice manifest through him and support him with victory,
help those who help him, forsake those who forsake him, crush those who seek to crush him, and through him crush the tyrants of disbelief,
and through him destroy the disbelievers, the hypocrites and all the heretics wherever they are, in the east and west of the earth, on its land and its sea,
fill the earth with justice through him and make the religion of Your Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, prevail through him,
and make me, O Allah, among his supporters, his helpers, his followers and his Shia,
and show me, regarding the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, what they hope for, and regarding their enemy what they fear,
O God of truth, Amen! O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

intro_en: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: whoever visits al-Husayn on the day of Ashura and stays weeping by him will meet Allah on the Day of Resurrection with the reward of two thousand Hajj, two thousand ʿUmrah and two thousand campaigns alongside the Prophet and the Imams. He told ʿAlqamah that one who is far from the grave should go out to the open or up onto a rooftop before noon, point toward the Imam with a greeting, curse his killers and pray two rakʿahs; then say the takbir and recite this ziyarah. Whoever does so has said what the angels who visit al-Husayn say, and the reward of the visit of all the prophets and all those who have visited him is recorded for him. (Narrated in Misbah al-Mutahajjid of al-Tusi and Kamil al-Ziyarat.)

sections.t_en: Peace be upon you, O Aba ʿAbdillah. Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah. Peace be upon you, O chosen one of Allah and son of His chosen one. Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful and son of the chief of the successors. Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah, the leader of the women of the worlds. Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance, and the lone one who was wronged and whose blood is still unavenged.
Peace be upon you, and upon the souls that have alighted in your courtyard. May the peace of Allah be upon all of you from me forever, as long as I live and as long as night and day remain.

O Aba ʿAbdillah, the calamity has been great and grievous, and your misfortune has been immense for us and for all the people of Islam; your misfortune has been grievous and immense in the heavens, for all the inhabitants of the heavens.

So may Allah curse the people who laid the foundation of oppression and injustice against you, O Household. May Allah curse the people who pushed you away from your station and removed you from the ranks that Allah had placed you in. May Allah curse the people who killed you. And may Allah curse those who prepared the ground for them and enabled them to fight you.
I declare before Allah and before you my disassociation from them, from their followers, their adherents and their allies.
O Aba ʿAbdillah, I am at peace with whoever is at peace with you, and at war with whoever wages war against you, until the Day of Resurrection.

May Allah curse the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan. May Allah curse the Banu Umayyah altogether. May Allah curse the son of Marjanah. May Allah curse ʿUmar ibn Saʿd. May Allah curse Shimr. And may Allah curse the people who saddled, bridled and masked themselves to fight you.

May my father and mother be sacrificed for you. My grief for you is truly great. So I ask Allah, Who honored your station and honored me through you, to grant me the chance to avenge you, together with a victorious Imam from the Household of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family.
O Allah, make me distinguished in Your sight through al-Husayn, peace be upon him, in this world and the Hereafter.
O Aba ʿAbdillah, I draw near to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful, to Fatimah, to al-Hasan, and to you, through loyalty to you,

and through disassociation from those who fought you and waged war against you, and from those who laid the foundation of oppression and injustice against you. I disassociate myself before Allah and His Messenger from those who laid the foundation of all this, built their structure upon it, and continued in their oppression and injustice against you and your followers.

I declare before Allah and before you my disassociation from them. I draw near to Allah, and then to you, through loyalty to you and to those loyal to you, and through disassociation from your enemies and those who waged war against you, and from their followers and adherents.
I am at peace with whoever is at peace with you, at war with whoever fights you, a friend of whoever befriends you, and an enemy of whoever is hostile to you.

So I ask Allah, Who honored me with knowing you and knowing your friends, and granted me disassociation from your enemies, to place me with you in this world and the Hereafter, and to establish for me with you a firm footing of truthfulness in this world and the Hereafter.
I ask Him to let me reach the praiseworthy station you hold with Allah, and to grant me the chance to seek vengeance, together with a manifest, truth-speaking Imam of guidance from among you.

I ask Allah, by your right and by the standing you have with Him, to give me for my grief over you the best that He gives to anyone afflicted by a calamity—a calamity how great it is, and how immense its grief is, in Islam and in all the heavens and the earth.

O Allah, in this station of mine make me among those who receive Your blessings, mercy and forgiveness. O Allah, make my life the life of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and my death the death of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

O Allah, this is a day that the Banu Umayyah and the son of the liver-eater—the accursed, son of the accursed, upon Your tongue and the tongue of Your Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, in every place and every standing where Your Prophet stood—regarded as blessed.

O Allah, curse Abu Sufyan, Muʿawiyah and Yazid son of Muʿawiyah; may Your curse be upon them forever and ever. And this is a day when the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan rejoiced because they killed al-Husayn, Allah's blessings be upon him. O Allah, so double Your curse and painful punishment upon them.

O Allah, I draw near to You on this day, in this standing of mine, and on all the days of my life, by disassociating myself from them and cursing them, and by loyalty to Your Prophet and the family of Your Prophet, peace be upon him and upon them.

O Allah, curse the first oppressor who wronged the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and the last follower who went along with him in that. O Allah, curse the band that fought al-Husayn, and those who sided with them, pledged allegiance to them and followed them in killing him. O Allah, curse them all.

Peace be upon you, O Aba ʿAbdillah, and upon the souls that have alighted in your courtyard. May the peace of Allah be upon you from me forever, as long as I live and as long as night and day remain. May Allah not make this the last of my visits to you.
Peace be upon al-Husayn, upon ʿAli ibn al-Husayn, upon the children of al-Husayn, and upon the companions of al-Husayn.

O Allah, single out the first oppressor for my curse, and begin with him first; then curse the second, the third and the fourth. O Allah, curse Yazid as the fifth, and curse ʿUbaydullah ibn Ziyad, the son of Marjanah, ʿUmar ibn Saʿd, Shimr, the family of Abu Sufyan, the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan, until the Day of Resurrection.

O Allah, to You belongs all praise, the praise of those who thank You for their afflictions. Praise be to Allah for my great grief. O Allah, grant me the intercession of al-Husayn on the Day of arrival, and make firm for me a footing of truthfulness with You, together with al-Husayn and the companions of al-Husayn, who gave their lives for al-Husayn, peace be upon him.
sections.note_en: Then go into prostration and say in it:

intro_en:
The Ziyarah of Aminullah is highly esteemed as is cited in all books of Ziyarah. In the words of `Allamah al-Majlisi (r.a), this form is the best in text and chain of authority. It is recommended to say it at all of the holy shrines. It is worth mentioning that the Ziyarah of Aminullah is considered one of the general forms of Ziyarah of Imam `Ali (a.s), one of the private forms of Ziyarah on the Eid al-Ghadir Day, and one of the comprehensive forms of Ziyarah that can be said at all the shrines of the Holy Imams (a.s).

Imam al-Baqir (a.s) added, “Indeed, any one of our adherents (Shi`ah) who pronounces these words at the tomb of Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s) or the tomb of one of the Imams (a.s) shall certainly have his prayer lifted up on a ladder of light, carrying the seal of the Holy Prophet’s ring, and it shall be kept so until it will be delivered to the Riser from Muhammad’s Household (namely, Imam al-Mahdi (a.s)) who will receive that person with good tidings, greetings, and honor.”

Through considerable chain of authority, it is narrated on the authority of Jabir ibn `Abdullah al-Ansari (r.a) on the authority of Imam al-Baqir (a.s) that Imam Zayn al-`Abidin (a.s), once, visited the holy tomb of Imam `Ali (a.s). He stood at the tomb, wept, and pronounced the following words:

sections.t_en: O' Alláh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
In the Name of Alláh, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah on His lands and argument of Allah against His servants.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
I bear witness that you strove for the sake of Allah as it ought to be striven, acted upon His Book, and followed the instructions of His Prophet, peace of Allah be upon him and his Household,
until Allah called you to be in His vicinity. So, He grasped you to Him by His will
and put your enemies under the claim although you have inclusive claims against all of His creatures.
O Allah, (please do) cause my soul to be fully tranquil with Your decrees, satisfied with Your acts,
fond of mentioning and praying to You, bearing love for the choicest of Your intimate servants,
beloved in Your lands and heavens, steadfast against the affliction of Your tribulations,
thankful for Your graceful bounties, always bearing in mind Your incessant gifts,
longing for the gladness of meeting You, supplied with piety for the day of Your rewarding,
pursuing the morals of Your intimate servants, quitting the conducts of Your enemies,
and distracted from this world by praising and thanking You.
O Allah, the hearts of those humbling themselves to You are fascinated,
sections.note_en: The Imam (a.s) then put his cheek on the tomb and said:

sections.t_en: the paths of those desiring for You are open,
the signs of those directing to You are evident,
the hearts of those having recognition of You are resorting to You,
the voices of those beseeching You are mounting up to You,
the doors of responding to them are wide open,
the prayer of him who speaks to You confidentially is responded,
the repentance of him who turns to You modestly is admitted,
the tear of him who weeps on account of fear from You is compassionated,
the aid of him who seeks Your aid is available,
the help of him who seeks Your help is obtainable,
Your promises to Your servants are fulfilled,
the slips of him who implore You to excuse him are forgivable,
the deeds of those who act for You are preserved,
Your sustenance to the creatures are descending from You,
Your gifts for further conferrals are reaching them,
the sins of those imploring Your forgiveness are forgiven,
the requests of Your creatures are granted by You,
the prizes of those begging You are offered,
Your gifts for further conferrals are uninterrupted,
the dining tables for those seeking Your feeding are prepared,
and the springs of quenching their thirst are brimful.
O Allah, (so) respond to my prayer, accept my thanksgiving to You, and join me to my masters,
[I beseech You] in the name of Muhammad, `Ali, Fatimah, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn.
You are verily the only source of my boons, the ultimate goal of my wishes, and the target of my hope in my recourses and settlement.
You are verily my God, Master, and Lord. (Please) forgive our friends, prevent our enemies against us,
sections.note_en: In the book of Kamil al-Ziyarat, the following statements are added to this form of Ziyarah:

sections.t_en: distract them from harming us, give prevalence to the Word of Truth and make it the supreme,
and frustrate the word of falsehood and make it the lowliest. Verily, You have power over all things.
O' Alláh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

intro_en: When you wish to visit the infallible Imams (peace be upon them), perform ghusl and proceed in a state of purity and dignity. When you reach the threshold of the shrine, say the takbir and recite this noble ziyarat.

sections.t_en: Peace be upon you, O Household of Prophethood, the location of the Divine Message, the place visited by angels, the landing place of Revelation, the source of Mercy, the treasurers of Knowledge, the pinnacle of Forbearance, the roots of Generosity, the leaders of nations, the guardians of blessings, the elements of the righteous, the pillars of the good, the administrators of the servants, the supports of the lands, the gates of Faith, the trusted ones of the All-Merciful, the lineage of the Prophets, the elite of the Messengers, and the progeny of the best of the Lord of the worlds, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be upon you.

Peace be upon the Imams of Guidance, the lamps in the darkness, the signposts of Piety, the possessors of intellect, the masters of wisdom, the refuge for mankind, the heirs of the Prophets, the highest Example, the call to the Best, and the proofs of Allah over the people of this world, the Hereafter, and the former life; and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be upon you.

I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, Alone without any partner... And I bear witness that you are the rightly-guided, guided Imams, the infallible, the honored, the near ones to Allah, the God-fearing, the truthful, the chosen, the obedient to Allah, the upholders of His command, the workers according to His will, and the winners of His grace.

He who adheres to you has adhered to Allah, he who antagonizes you has antagonized Allah, he who loves you has loved Allah, he who hates you has hated Allah, and he who holds fast to you has held fast to Allah... May my father, my mother, my soul, my family, and my wealth be sacrificed for you!

O Allah! If I knew intercessors closer to You than Muhammad and his righteous Household—the pious Imams—I would have chosen them as my intercessors. So by the right You have made obligatory upon Yourself for them, I ask You to include me among those who know them and their right, and among those shown mercy through their intercession. Indeed, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
